purpose: Name the product and make one evidenced outcome clear within the first three seconds.
whenToUse: A product name and defensible one-line result are available
whenNotToUse: The proposed result cannot be supported by the input or captured assets
requiredInputs: one licensed logo or product visual

layoutContract.safeArea: Keep identity and outcome inside the configured safe area; preserve logo clear space.
layoutContract.density: Use one headline and at most one supporting line.

motionContract.entrance: Reveal the product identity first, then the outcome and product visual.
motionContract.determinism: Use a paused finite timeline with no random or clock-dependent values.
motionContract.continuity: Hold a readable hero frame before leaving the scene.

transitionOptions.use: Carry a brand shape into the problem scene.
Use when the next scene has unrelated geometry.

captionRules.copy: Keep captions shorter than narration and avoid repeating the complete headline.
captionRules.placement: Keep clear of the product name, logo, and focal UI.

fallbacks.condition: logo is missing or too small
fallbacks.action: Use a typographic product-name card with verified brand colors.
Replace it with the verified one-line product description.

qaRules: Product name or core result is readable by 00:03
No unsupported metric or testimonial appears
